title: English Practice Quiz 0913
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Orders were 18 on Monday and 24 on Tuesday. How many more on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: 6 is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A team completed 45 of 60 tasks. What fraction is this?
questions.explanation: Three quarters is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Sales rose from 200 units to 250 units. What was the increase?
questions.explanation: 50 units is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: 12 of 40 forms contain errors. How many are error-free?
questions.explanation: 28 is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A chart shows the highest sales in April. Which month had the greatest sales?
questions.explanation: April is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Expenses are 300, 450 and 250. What is the total?
questions.explanation: 1,000 is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A service received 80 calls and answered 68. How many were unanswered?
questions.explanation: 12 is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A quantity falls from 90 to 75. What is the decrease?
questions.explanation: 15 is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Five workers process 100 files equally. How many files each?
questions.explanation: 20 is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A target is 500 and actual output is 460. How far below target?
questions.explanation: 40 is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
